{{EventEnd|date = 24th of March 2025}} {{For|The [[The Hunt Event]]}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = TheHuntMegaEditionPI.png |dates = 13 March 2025 – 24 March 2025 |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:The_Hunt: Mega Edition|The Hunt: Mega Edition]] |previous_event = [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E]] |next_event = [[April Fools 2025 Event|Baseplate]] }} ==Description== '''The Hunt: Mega Edition Event''' was the twentieth event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. This was a Roblox sponsored event that took part in [[w:c:roblox:The_Hunt: Mega Edition|The Hunt: Mega Edition]] event. The event was released on the 13th of March 2025 at 19:00 UTC and ended on 24 March 2025 at 19:00 UTC. According to the dialogue, this event was a sequel of the previous [[The Hunt Event|Hunt Event]]. This event consisted of three difficulties: Easy, Mega and Impossible. The Easy difficulty gave the {{Color|Korblox|Korblox}} [[Soldier]] skin and the Standard Token for [[w:c:roblox:The_Hunt: Mega Edition|The Hunt: Mega Edition]] Roblox event. The Mega difficulty gave a badge, the [[KorbloxHunter Nametag]] and the Mega Token for [[w:c:roblox:The_Hunt: Mega Edition|The Hunt: Mega Edition]] with significantly higher rewards than the Easy difficulty. The Impossible difficulty only gave a badge and significantly higher rewards than the Easy and Mega difficulty. 1 Total |} ==Badges== {{Badge |title = Korblox Token |description = Repel the vengeful empire on Easy difficulty. |image = KorbloxToken.png |rewards = Standard Token & {{Color|Korblox|Korblox}} [[Soldier]] |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = Return from the Abyss |description = Face the Deathwalker and his army at true strength in impossible mode |image = RetrunFromAbyss.png |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = Sigil of the Deathwalker |description = Following whispers of an ancient power, the path to vengeance is complete. |image = SigilofDeathwalker.png |rewards = Mega Token & [[KorbloxHunter Nametag]] |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = The Korblox Code |description = Think on what you've just unleashed |image = KorbloxCode.png |obtainable = No }} ==Official Event Trailer== [[File:The Hunt- Mega Edition Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TheHuntMegaIcon.png {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheHuntMegaThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TheHuntMegaEditionPI.png }} ==Trivia== [[File:TheHuntDuck.png|125px|thumb|A [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]] behind the portal.]] *In the lobby area for '''The Hunt: Mega Edition Event''', a small [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]] could have been found behind the portal to the event. **This was a teaser for the upcoming [[Ducky Revenge Event]], released on the 16th of April. *For the Mega Token Quest, there were two clues which hinted at the code required for the supercomputer. **There was a Redcliff shield which was located on one of the lobby walls underneath some undergrowth. **There were various letters around the main lobby and event area which spelled out the word "FALLS". ***These two clues combined hinted at the "Redcliff Falls" code which would be input into the supercomputer to activate Mega difficulty in [[Korblox Temple]]. **Other clues were provided in the lobby. These were for a scrapped activation method for the Mega difficulty, cancelled due to data miners. ***Ultimately, they were kept as red herrings. These were: ****The words on the [[Korblox Temple]] portal spelling out the word "SURVIVES". ****The Redcliff logo on the Commander hat. *****These would have been used in a riddle to activate Mega difficulty. *''The Korblox Code'' badge was a fake badge used to mislead players and data miners from discovering the true Mega Token quest. {{EventNavBox}}
